scripts.build:windows: PATH="$(brew --prefix llvm)/bin:$PATH" tauri build --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.test: pnpm --filter frontend test:unit && cd backend && cargo test
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && cd backend && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check
scripts.format: pnpm --filter frontend format && cd backend && cargo fmt
